sections.Profile:
Bowl-O , released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in April 1970, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine with a bowling theme. Designed by Jim Patla and Marty Rosenthal, and featuring artwork by Christian Marche, Bowl-O stands out for its immersive sports-themed gameplay.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1970
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Bowling, Sports, Original Theme, 1970s

- Art: Christian Marche
- Design: Jim Patla
- Design: Marty Rosenthal
